verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents an official MCP integration for coding agents with OAuth 2.1 authentication, no API keys, and tools to list services, run SQL, and read monitoring. It also speaks the native ClickHouse protocol and HTTP interface, so any ClickHouse CLI or driver can query and read results without a dashboard. Governance comes from table- and column-scoped roles, full per-query logging of agent reads, and isolated read-only agent compute, while CHKit offers typed commands to describe schema. Missing for 10: an explicit MCP schema-discovery tool (discovery is implied via SQL or CHKit's describe), independent or hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end agent flow.
